title: agentopology --json findings document
description: What `agentopology validate --json` and `agentopology guard --check --json` print on stdout: one document holding the findings of the language's own checks.

target.description: The --target given, or for guard --check the target graded.

exitCode.description: The process exit code, the same as without --json.

id.description: The rule or check id, such as V12, CX3, guard.gate, parse.

file.description: The file the finding is about, as given on the command line or relative to the project.

line.description: 1-based line in file, or null when the check has none.

source.description: The check that produced the finding.
